items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: One of the lyrical theater was in full bloom there with the old man Robichaud.

ctx.x: Go Re Mi Fa So La Ti Do. You had to sing it and play it. Play it, sing it. And he tell you play it just like you sing it. Well, this sort of girl had the band. She was at the Lyric Theater. One of the lyrical theater was in full bloom there with the old man Robichaud. Well, that was one playing piano in Helen Edwards. She died in California, 1950. I believe she died in California, 1950. Yeah, she was great. She was great pianist. Transposition was just like playing the original copy.
